It's that time of year—to save the date for POSETTE: An Event for Postgres 2027, a free & virtual developer event organized by the Postgres team at Microsoft, in partnership with AMD.

🗓️ Save the date 🗓️ POSETTE 2027 will take place on 30 & 31 March 2027 https://posetteconf.com/

The CFP will be open soon, later in November. In the meantime we hope you mark your calendars so you can be part of POSETTE 2027!

#PostgreSQL #Postgres #OpenSource #Azure #Microsoft #PosetteConf #conference
